snippet.title: In Harry Potter (2001–2011), Gary Oldman admits he thinks his performance was "mediocre".
snippet.description:
In Harry Potter (2001–2011), Gary Oldman admits he thinks his performance was "mediocre" because he didn't read the books beforehand. He believes he would have played Sirius Black much differently if he had known the ending in advance like Alan Rickman did.
